data.title: Peter Schiff Warns Of ‘A Black Monday’ For BitMine And Ethereum ETFs If ETH Loses Key Support
data.description: Peter Schiff said Ethereum would drop below $1,000 in April 2025 but the token didn't drop that low. On Aug. 24, 2025, the token reached a record $4,954.
